published.title: The 19th-century portrait that looked back (Fiction)
published.summary: An art restorer cleans layers of grime off an obscure 19th-century portrait, only to uncover a chilling reality behind the canvas. What secret is hidden inside the frame?

published.title: The Memory Broker's Vault (Fiction)
published.summary: Seeking an escape from isolation, a woman purchases an illicit vial containing a warm childhood picnic. But as the sensory memory sets in, the warmth turns into an unbearable weight.

published.title: The reflection that moved a second too late (Fiction)
published.summary: A man installs a massive antique mirror in his hallway and notices a subtle delay in his reflection's movements. When he tries to test the glass in the dark, he uncovers something truly terrifying.

published.title: The Golden Message Sent Into Deep Space
published.summary: Discover the incredible story behind the Voyager Golden Record, a time capsule of humanity sent into interstellar space in 1977.

published.title: The Unsolved Mystery of Dyatlov Pass
published.summary: In 1959, nine experienced Soviet ski hikers perished under mysterious circumstances in the Ural Mountains. While official investigations cited a natural force like an avalanche, bizarre physical evidence continues to spark debate.

topic_pool.title: The Quietest Town
topic_pool.premise: A linguistic researcher visits a remote village where inhabitants only speak in low, deliberate whispers. She thinks it's a reverence for nature, until she records the local lullaby and plays it backward to find it is actually a countdown timer for when the town's guardian falls asleep.

topic_pool.title: The Inkless Ledger
topic_pool.premise: An archivist cataloging municipal tax records from 1850 finds a blank ledger that suddenly grows dark ink lines whenever she places her bare palm on the page. The ledger begins accurately recording her own future financial transactions down to the exact minute.

topic_pool.title: Echoes of the Estate
topic_pool.premise: A professional house-sitter lives in a smart mansion that logs every sound to 'optimize home comfort.' The daily report flags an unauthorized voice whispering inside the walls, but the investigation reveals the voice isn't a trespasser—it's the house predicting what the sitter will say ten minutes before she speaks.

topic_pool.title: The Castaway Signal
topic_pool.premise: A solitary radio operator intercepts a distress call from an uninhabited polar island repeating a sequence of prime numbers. When he triangulates the signal, he discovers the transmission is coming from the internal GPS chip of his own handheld radio.

topic_pool.title: Blink
topic_pool.premise: A security guard watches live feeds of a high-security archive, noticing that every camera drops signal for one microsecond precisely at midnight. When he syncs a high-speed drone camera to bypass the blackout, he sees that the entire archive room is actually a colossal, shifting eye.

topic_pool.title: The Sleepwalker's Journal
topic_pool.premise: A chronic insomniac uses a sleep-tracking app that reconstructs his midnight movements into a 3D animated simulation. He watches himself walk to the basement every night and bury identical metal boxes, only to wake up and find his childhood bedroom filled with them.

topic_pool.title: Retinal Lag
topic_pool.premise: An optometrist fits a patient with a revolutionary smart-lens that claims to correct astigmatism instantly. Over the next week, the patient notices objects in her peripheral vision lagging behind reality by two seconds—until she sees herself standing behind her, waiting for her to move out of the way.

topic_pool.title: The Last Broadcast
topic_pool.premise: A podcaster obsessed with dead-air pirate radio stations tracks down a signal that plays only the sound of heavy breathing. He broadcasts it live, only to realize the breathing isn't coming from the tape—it's filling his soundproof booth from the ventilation shaft.

topic_pool.title: The 11:14 Loop
topic_pool.premise: A commuter realizes every passenger on her train car is performing the exact same micro-gestures in unison. When she breaks the sequence by coughing, the train plunges into darkness and all passengers turn to her with her own voice, demanding to know why she missed her cue.

topic_pool.title: Acoustic Wallpaper
topic_pool.premise: A sound engineer rents a cheap minimalist apartment that inexplicably dampens all noise from the outside world. He discovers the walls are woven from millions of human hair strands that are broadcasting the dying whispers of the building's previous tenants.

topic_pool.title: Subway Etiquette
topic_pool.premise: A late-night commuter plays a silent puzzle game on her phone, completely ignoring a stranger sitting opposite her who is desperately trying to mime a warning. When she finally looks up from her screen, she realizes she is the only living passenger, and the 'stranger' is her own reflection trapped in the tunnel glass.

topic_pool.angle: An illustrated codex written in an entirely unidentifiable language baffles cryptographers and historians who still cannot determine if it is an elaborate hoax or a lost medieval text.

A well-dressed man found dead on an Australian beach carried no identification except for a scrap of paper with Persian words meaning 'finished', sparking a decades-long international espionage puzzle.
An unidentified woman found burned in a remote Norwegian valley used multiple fake identities, coded notebooks, and wigs, suggesting a Cold War spy operation gone wrong.
Five US Navy torpedo bombers vanished over the Bermuda Triangle after their compasses malfunctioned, and the rescue plane sent to find them also disappeared without a trace.
A massive granite monument inscribed with ten guidelines for humanity was anonymously commissioned and erected before being mysteriously bombed and demolished.
Discovered in a ship wreck, an ancient Greek hand-powered analog computer predates similar technology by a millennium and accurately tracks astronomical positions.
For over two centuries, treasure hunters have excavated a water-logged pit in Nova Scotia filled with complex booby traps, yet the ultimate prize remains hidden.
A loosely defined region of the Atlantic Ocean where numerous ships and aircraft are claimed to have mysteriously vanished under supernatural or unexplained circumstances.
A strong narrowband radio signal detected by Jerry R. Ehman bore all the hallmarks of originating from outside the solar system, but was never detected again.

topic_pool.wiki_title: Disappearance of the Lead Masks of Vintém Hill
topic_pool.angle: Two electronic technicians were found dead on a Brazilian hill wearing homemade lead masks and sunglasses, with a notebook containing bizarre, cryptic time instructions.
Residents of a small New Mexico town are persistently tormented by a low-frequency buzzing sound that only a small percentage of the population can hear.
An American merchant brig was found drifting deserted and in seaworthy condition in the Atlantic Ocean, with all its cargo and crew inexplicably missing.
A sleek hijacker extorted a ransom, parachuted out of a commercial Boeing 727 into a freezing rainstorm, and vanished into American folklore forever.
An elite, highly complex internet puzzle surfaced online, recruiting brilliant minds through cryptography, steganography, and hidden physical clues around the globe.
A mysterious whispered audio artifact left behind in an abandoned recording studio revealed strange coordinates leading deep into an Arctic wasteland.
Recent forensic genealogy finally put a name to Australia's most famous unidentified corpse, but the man's secret life and cause of death remain deeply shrouded in mystery.
A 16th-century Ottoman cartographer drew a world map depicting Antarctic coastlines thousands of years before they were officially discovered, fueling theories of ancient exploration.
A cryptic sculpture installed at CIA headquarters contains four encrypted messages, and despite decades of work by codebreakers, the final section remains unsolved.
The autopsy of an unidentified man revealed unusual physical traits and a rare book connection that baffled Australian police in 1948.
A young Australian pilot reported a strange green aircraft following him before his radio transmission abruptly cut out with metallic scraping noises.
Six inhabitants of a remote German farmstead were murdered with a mattock after hearing strange footsteps in the attic and finding footprints leading from the snow into the forest.
An anomalous 18th-century timepiece kept exact astronomical time even after being completely submerged in saltwater for fifty years.
Distress calls from a Dutch freighter reported the entire crew dead with terrified expressions, and the ship exploded before it could be towed into port.
